method.scattering_factors: Gemmi IT92 neutral atoms; D uses H electron form factor
method.intensity: sum |F(hkl)|^2 over all reciprocal vectors with the same d, including Friedel pairs, normalized to maximum 100
method.omitted: Lorentz-polarization, absorption, preferred orientation, anomalous dispersion, thermal displacement and instrumental broadening
method.rounding: d: 10 decimal places; relative intensity: 8 decimal places

fe3s.qualification: Fe3P-type topology proxy from meteoritic (Fe,Ni)3P COD 9007338: replace all Ni by Fe and P by S. This is not a refined Fe3S structure or a prediction of experimental intensities. The existing Fe3S reference cell is retained.

iceviii.qualification: COD 1566661 is the cited Besson deuterated ice VIII structure at 2.8 GPa / 296 K. Reference cell retained. These are X-ray electron-scattering intensities, not neutron intensities; D has the H form factor.

majorite.qualification: COD 9010029 Angel et al. (1989), including reported Mg/Si occupational disorder. Calculate in the CIF native origin using its explicit symmetry operations. Existing EOSMAT sites use an equivalent x+1/2 origin. Reference cell retained.

mg7si2o8.qualification: COD 9006822 Kagi et al. (2000) supplies both heavy atoms and H sites, with the heavy-atom model inherited from Horiuchi et al. Reference cell remains the existing Horiuchi cell (7.8603,7.8603,9.573 A), rather than the slightly smaller CIF cell. Rounded special thirds are snapped within 5e-6 before symmetry expansion. No measured peak strengths are represented.

perovskite_orthorhombic.qualification: Pure MgSiO3 COD 9005757 (Yagi et al. 1978) geometry used as an explicit topology proxy for nominal Mg0.88Fe0.12SiO3. Replace the Mg site by 0.88 Mg + 0.12 Fe statistically; retain the existing EOS reference cell. No Fe-bearing specimen refinement or site preference determination is claimed.

phase_d.qualification: COD 9001848 Yang, Prewitt and Frost (1997), including reported occupancies, Mg1.11Si1.89H2.22O6 per cell. Retain existing reference cell. Rounded special thirds are snapped within 5e-6. No Fe site occupancy is invented: the EOS sample contains about 3.7 wt% Fe, so this is a structural surrogate.

mgfe60o.qualification: Independently authored ideal Fm-3m rocksalt model: 4a (0,0,0) with statistical 0.4 Mg + 0.6 Fe and 4b (1/2,1/2,1/2) O. This nominal model is dedicated to CC0 by the Peritheos contributors; numerical lattice constants remain attributed to Richet et al. (1989). No refined disorder or measured intensities are supplied.

feh2.qualification: Independent calculation using the published I4/mmm model: Fe 4e z=0.853 from the 67 GPa X-ray refinement, H 4c/4d from the original DFT model. Retain existing reference lattice a=2.714, c=9.2142 A rather than the 67 GPa experimental cell. Hydrogen sites are calculated, not experimentally refined; nominal FeH2 may have vacancies. No 2018 NC supplement is used. No claim of current thermodynamic stability or superiority over later hydrogen models.

sno2_cubic_27gpa.source_location: Introduction: Sn 4a and O 8c u=0.346 (reference model, not the refined 44.5 GPa value)
sno2_cubic_27gpa.qualification: Independent calculation from the reported ideal Pa-3 numerical model: Sn 4a and O 8c u=0.346 (Sneed et al. 2019). Use the existing reference cell, not a new pressure-dependent positional refinement. Source reports oxygen disorder; this ordered approximation does not model it. The 48 GPa structural reference does not extend the separate EOS 16.09-28.85 GPa applicability range. The retained u=0.346 is the introduction's reference value, not the paper's refined u=0.3343(5) at 44.5 GPa.
